name: SM_Dragon_Statue_PR

textures.channels: tangent normal, OpenGL (green up; flip green on import)
R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

material_exception: unique BC/N/ORM bake private to this asset (not a row of ART_STANDARD.md section 2): the task for the unclaimed families asks for a baked set per asset, and the surface detail here (see dresses) does not exist in the shared library
pivot: base centre (bbox centre in X/Y, mesh bottom at z = 0), front on -Y
dresses: stone statue of a dragon rearing on an orb, 3 m to the wing tips on a 1 m plinth: wings half raised, tail wound down round the orb, grey weathered stone with moss and lichen
status: source delivered; not imported into Unreal, not bound in families.json
known_weaknesses: The dragon is the creature source shrunk and fused, so it has the same invented anatomy, softened by the voxel fusion: claws, horns, teeth and wing fingers are blunt nubs, as on a worn carving, but nothing reads as tool-cut. Wing membranes are flat 27 mm slabs. The tail wraps the orb without touching it everywhere. Stone is one tinted rock scan with procedural moss and lichen; no bedding, chips or repairs. The original is a dark blue-grey statue lit from the side; this one is paler grey.
triangle_note: 9,000 triangles: above the 6,000 soft target of class prop (hard cap 20,000), spent on the wings and the wound tail
